summary:
Revised SovereignShell implementation plan aligned with the 4 Deepink / Deepink Arcade reference mockups:
1. Eliminates "developer plumbing projection" from user-facing cards and screens (hiding raw Kind numbers, SHA-256 hashes, and relay URLs inside an on-demand Inspector sheet instead of cluttering cards).
2. Full-screen Running Nsite WebView with a single floating top-left Avatar / ≠ Medallion FAB ("FAB Wrapper / Settings ID") instead of a developer toolbar.
3. Deepink visual language: bold condensed Bone Cream (#E8DCC8) headers, taped/tilted label strips, distressed Deep Pink (#FF1493) CTA buttons with ">>>" arrows, jagged pink telemetry waveforms on the Node/Network screen, left slide-out drawer, and the bottom navigation dock featuring the raised glowing "≠" center FAB.
